lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Family of CFB Wainwright burn victim honour him at Remembrance Day in St. Albert, Global News reports.
Molson Canadian, Coors Light, Blue Moon and other popular beer brands are being recalled across Canada due to the presence of metal, The Canadian Press reports.
At 102 and 101, Richard Earl and Stephen Andrushko are among the few remaining Canadians who can tell what the Second World War was like first-hand, The Canadian Press reports.
A soldier guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier issued a verbal reprimand to a group of advisers and staffers with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth following a, The Canadian Press reports.

The federal government was actively and intensively part of discussions that ended in the agreement to sell a Stellantis car assembly plant to Canadian armoured vehicle manufacturer Roshel, according to three sources with direct knowledge of the talks, CP24 reports.
How Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair could cause collateral damage in Washington, The Associated Press reports.
